statements.t: We are reiterating our full-year revenue outlook while increasing our minimum expectations for Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted EBITDA and continue to advance SG-001 as a potential additional long-term growth opportunity.

ADMA’s mission is to manufacture, market and develop specialty plasma-derived, human immune globulins targeted to niche patient populations for the treatment and prevention of certain infectious diseases and management of immune compromised patient populations who suffer from an underlying immune deficiency, or who may be immune compromised for other medical reasons.
